title: Static targets 10mmol/l (overwritten) in TT when using simple mode
body:
Version: 3.3.2.0

When using Simple Mode (Preferences > General > Simple mode ON) the Temporary targets for "Eating soon", "Activity" and "Hypo" are all set to 10mmol/l.

The TT are also not be able to change when simple mode is activated. When Simple mode is OFF, the TT targets are using the correct values. Also the abiliby to change this defaults are exposed in the preferences.

comments.body: @MilosKozak i believe this will be fixed in next master release in b869a73
@arnowesterdijk update to 3.3.2.1 and try again. I believe it is working fine now.
